title: What 5/8 Means as a Percent
description: Filling in parts of a whole to turn the fraction 5/8 into a percent.
narration_lines: Split a whole into 8 equal parts.
Now fill in 5 of those 8 parts.
Five eighths is 62.5 percent -- the bottom number is how many parts, the top is how many you have.
